description: ACCDB: closes ADO-RESYNC open question: tests whether clean vs pending-edit vs conflicted (post-failed-UpdateBatch) rows refresh UnderlyingValue under Resync(..., adResyncUnderlyingValues). rs1 (NO failed UpdateBatch): row 1 pending edit V=120, row 4 clean V=40; cn2 updates rows 1..4 to 110..410; 8s pause; Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncUnderlyingValues) on rs1 checks BOTH row 1 and clean row 4. rs2 (WITH failed UpdateBatch): row 2 V=220 and row 3 V=320; row 2 hits 0x80040E38 -> Resync(adAffectCurrent, adResyncUnderlyingValues) -> UpdateBatch(adAffectCurrent) succeeds; row 3 hits 0x80040E38 -> Filter=adFilterConflictingRecords -> Resync(adAffectGroup, adResyncUnderlyingValues) -> UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) succeeds. Keeps all pages.
